description: Step 1 of a free quote for a cross-chain transfer. Computes the exact message the agent's EVM wallet must sign (EIP-191 personal_sign) for one Recta request, and the headers to send. Holds no key and calls nothing. Then call recta_send_signed_request with the same method, path, idempotency_key, body and issued_at, plus the signature. Start with POST /v1/golden-corridor/commercial-evaluations (body: recta_request_template; its "sender" must be the signing address). If you have no wallet tool that can personal_sign, this server cannot sign for you: No signing code needed: the npm package @recta/client builds, checks and signs the request for you, and @recta/mcp (`npx -y @recta/mcp`) is a local MCP server that does it as tools: without a key it offers only the free fit check and trial; with RECTA_PRIVATE_KEY of a dedicated wallet (kept on your machine) it signs too. Evaluations are free and need no funds. Paying a fee needs the fee in USDC on Base and a USDC allowance to Permit2 (an ERC-20 approve of USDC to Permit2), besides the transfer itself when it starts from Base USDC.

body.description: The exact JSON body text, byte for byte as it will be sent. Empty for GET.
